**`HealthBehaviour.java` (new interface)** — three mutating operations (`progressDisease`, `tryAcquireDisease`, `tryInfectFrom`) plus read-only `isInfected`/`isImmune`. `tryAcquireDisease` takes `(Animal self, Field field, SimRandom rand)` rather than a pre-computed boolean, so `surroundingsInfected()` is called lazily inside the component only when the animal is susceptible — preserving the original RNG-consumption sequence exactly.

**`StandardHealthBehaviour.java` (new class)** — owns `infected`, `immune`, and the four probability constants removed from `Animal`. `progressDisease` reproduces the exact if/else chain from the original (including the immunity-waning branch in the `else`, which ran unconditionally in the original even when neither infected nor immune). `tryInfectFrom` encapsulates the diseased-prey infection path that `CarnivoreDiet` previously performed inline with direct field writes.

**`Animal.java`** — removed 6 fields (`infected`, `immune`, `diseaseProbability`, `diseaseSpreadProbability`, `deathFromInfectionProbability`, `immuneProbability`). The two health blocks in `act()` collapse to two lines. `getIsInfected()`/`getIsImmune()` delegate to `health`. `populate()` reads `health.isInfected()`/`health.isImmune()`. New `protected tryInfectFrom(boolean, SimRandom)` delegates to `health` so `CarnivoreDiet` can trigger infection without touching health state directly.

**`CarnivoreDiet.java`** — removed three direct field accesses (`self.immune`, `self.diseaseSpreadProbability`, `self.infected = true`). Replaced with `self.tryInfectFrom(prey.getIsInfected(), rand)`, which preserves the conditional RNG call: `rand.nextDouble()` is consumed only when the source is infected and the predator is not immune — identical to the original.
